newsitem.title: USA: Ameristar sets opening for hotel/casino.
newsitem.headline: Ameristar sets opening for hotel/casino.

text.p: Ameristar Casinos Inc Monday said it expects to open The Reserve Hotel & Casino in a suburb of Las Vegas by January 1998 at a cost of $118 million.

In a statement, Ameristar also announced the Nevada Gaming Commission recently approved a settlement between the company and former stockholders of Gem Gaming Inc, the original developer of The Reserve. Under the settlement, Ameristar will pay the former Gem stockholders $32.7 million plus interest in installments through 2004. Further details were undisclosed.
The Reserve will be located in Henderson/Green Valley at the junction of Interstate 515 and Lake Mead Drive. About 100,000 vehicles per day pass the intersection.
The hotel/casino will have a safari theme featuring 224 rooms and an exotic swimming pool in a tropical setting.
The casino will encompass about 42,000 square feet holding 1,350 slot machines and 26 table games, a racing and sports book, keno, a poker room and a bingo area.
